title: 2027 Honda Civic Type R yenilenen yüzü ve yeni özellikleriyle duyuruldu
summary: Honda Civic Type R, 2027 model yılı için ısıtmalı ön koltuklar, geliştirilmiş soğutma sistemi ve hafif fiyat artışıyla yenilendi.
body:
Car and Driver'ın aktardığına göre 2027 Honda Civic Type R, performans odaklı güncellemeler, tasarım dokunuşları ve yeni standart özelliklerle birlikte duyuruldu. Otomobil, daha iyi soğutma sağlayan ön tasarım, artırılmış ön yere basma kuvveti ve daha hızlı çalışan bir vites eşleme sistemi gibi mekanik yeniliklerle geliyor.

## Öne çıkan yenilikler ve konfor

Model serisinde ilk kez ısıtmalı ön koltuklar standart olarak sunuluyor. Kabin içinde ise kaymayı önlemek için güncellenen ön koltuk delikleri, gösterge paneli ve kapılarda süet kaplamalar yer alıyor. Ayrıca daha koyu gri renkte kaplanan alüminyum vites topuzu, siyah klima düğmeleri ve otomatik kararan dikiz aynası da kabindeki yenilikler arasında bulunuyor. Sürüş dinamikleri tarafında ise +R modu elden geçirilirken, fren pedalına eklenen yay ile daha doğrudan bir pedal hissi hedefleniyor.

## Fiyat ve çıkış tarihi

Geçen yıl 48.690 dolar olan başlangıç fiyatı, yapılan güncellemelerin ardından 2027 modeli için **49.990 dolar** seviyesine yükseldi. Otomobil, bu ay içinde bayilerde yerini almaya başlayacak.

**Neden önemli?** Yapılan güncellemeler ve özellikle ısıtmalı koltuk gibi yeni standart özellikler, 2027 Honda Civic Type R modelini sınıfındaki diğer seçenekler karşısında daha avantajlı bir konuma getiriyor.

source_texts.title: 2027 Honda Civic Type R Adds Performance, Enhances Interior
source_texts.summary: Honda’s hottest hatch gets more aggressive styling, improves aero and cooling, and steals the seat warmers from the Acura Integra Type S.
source_texts.text:
- The 2027 Honda Civic Type R gets hard-to-spot visual changes, improved cooling, more downforce over the front wheels, and a quicker rev-match system, among other tweaks.
- Perhaps of more practical interest for buyers is that the updated Civic Type R now comes with heated front seats, which were previously limited to the Acura Integra Type S.
- The changes come along with a slight price increase, with the 2027 Type R starting at $49,990 when it starts arriving at dealers later this month.
One change in particular for the 2027 Honda Civic Type R is going to make the Acura Integra Type S a much harder sell. While Honda’s magnificent hot hatch is getting a host of updates, including some subtle visual changes, better cooling, improved downforce, and quicker rev matching, there’s one change in particular we care about. For the first time since the FL5-generation CTR launched, the Honda comes with heated buckets.

Aside from toasting our buns to a perfect golden brown, the Type R should be slightly better to drive from 2027. Honda tweaked the front fascia design to improve cooling, and while we believe Honda enlarged the grille, our eyes struggle to see the visual changes. Still, the new look apparently shoves more air into the engine, while a deeper front splitter pushes the front axle harder into the ground and reduces turbulence.
Tweaks to the CTR’s aggressive +R mode are meant to improve road following, reduce bouncing, and cut back on impact harshness to supply more stability and improve control. Other changes include the addition of a yoke spring to the brake pedal, which now provides a more direct feel, and a quicker engine response from the rev-match system to provide smoother downshifts. If vanity adjustments matter to you, Honda is also adding a new Meteorite Gray Metallic option, while the engine cover gets a redesign reminiscent of engines in early-generation Type Rs.
The rest of the changes to the Type R are focused on the cabin, with Honda updating the front-seat perforation to reduce sliding, as well as adding suede to the instrument panel and upper front door panels. The door handles and, more important, the aluminum shift knob are now finished in a darker gray color. The climate control and air vent knobs have been painted black to give the cabin a more upscale look, and the Type R now comes standard with an auto-dimming rearview mirror.
Unfortunately, the changes have caused the price of the Civic Type R to rise slightly. The 2027 model will start at $49,990, up from $48,690 last year. The updated hot hatch will start arriving at dealerships later this month and now serve as an even more compelling option over the Acura Integra Type S.

Jack Fitzgerald’s love for cars stems from his as yet unshakable addiction to Formula 1. 
After a brief stint as a detailer for a local dealership group in college, he knew he needed a more permanent way to drive all the new cars he couldn’t afford and decided to pursue a career in auto writing. By hounding his college professors at the University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee, he was able to travel Wisconsin seeking out stories in the auto world before landing his dream job at Car and Driver. His new goal is to delay the inevitable demise of his 2010 Volkswagen Golf.
